accountabilityNote: This project has a single maintainer, so plan A6’s backup reviewer cannot be satisfied by a person. The second pair of eyes is mechanical: a refresh lands as a pull request whose generated diff is reviewable, and reference:check gates it. Known failure mode: while the maintainer is unavailable, the freshness workflow reports a changed upstream input to a queue nobody else reads, so the reference goes stale silently rather than loudly. Phase 5 reduces the exposure by having that workflow open the refresh pull request itself.
